setting: Set in top of concrete monument
stability: May hold commonly subject to ground movement
description: AK 45 is located in the Picacho-Eloy land subsidence feature being monitored by the Arizona Department of Water Resources using Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (InSAR) data. In addition to the InSAR data, ADWR collects static GNSS data on several monuments in the area annually. This elevation should be verified before using as a vertical control point. For more information on the Picacho-Eloy land subsidence feature or land subsidence in Arizona, visit www.azwater.gov.
